fact: On 30 September-1 October 2026 Paradigm Initiative and ACSIS-Tchad held a Digital Policy Engagement Series workshop in N'Djamena with institutions, academics and civil society reviewing the data protection and cybercrime laws, with recommendations expected to feed the future Code du numérique.
title: Tchad : la protection des données au cœur des échanges à N'Djamena
